name: Ocean West Boutique Hotel

pages.title: Boutique Hotel on West Bay Street, Nassau | Ocean West
pages.desc: Ocean West: a 10-room boutique hotel 70 ft above sea level on West Bay Street, Nassau, between Lake Killarney and the Atlantic. 5 minutes from the airport.

pages.title: The Ten Gem Rooms | Ocean West Boutique Hotel, Nassau
pages.desc: Compare Ocean West's ten rooms, Diamond to Coral: king, queen and twin beds, ocean, pool and lake views, private balconies. Rates from $215 a night, Nassau.

pages.title: Amenities, Policies & Getting Here | Ocean West, Nassau
pages.desc: Pool, rooftop gym, massage suite and bars at Ocean West, Nassau. Check-in 3pm, 24-hour desk, kids under 12 free, and directions from the airport via West Bay St.

faq: How far is Ocean West from Nassau airport?
About a five minute drive from Lynden Pindling International Airport. Airport transport is available at a surcharge.
What are the check-in and check-out times?
Check-in is at 3pm and check-out at 11am. Late check-out until 2pm is $30. The front desk is open 24 hours.
Children under 12 stay free. Rates are for single and double occupancy; rollaway beds are $100 a night.
No. A traditional or Bahamian breakfast is served a la carte.
No pets are allowed on the premises, and all rooms are non-smoking.

findings: Every page has the same keyword-stuffed title, "Bahamas Boutique Hotel, Vacation Rental Bahamas, Bahamian Accommodations", so Google cannot tell your pages apart.
Headings are pictures inside tables: phones and search engines cannot read them, and the layout does not adapt to a phone.
Your address and phone number are not on the homepage.
Ten beautifully named gem rooms appear as small thumbnails with no way to compare beds, views or balconies.
Your best story, 70 feet up between Lake Killarney and the Atlantic, is a single sentence.
improvements: A first screen that draws the ridge, the lake and the ocean, with every window a clickable room.
A room selector and a filter (balcony, king bed, two beds, view) that make your ten rooms easy to choose.
Your real booking engine one tap away on every screen, plus an enquiry that names the room.
Plain policies and step-by-step directions from the airport.
Proper titles and Hotel markup so 'boutique hotel West Bay Street Nassau' finds you.
